items.title: CVNA Q3 deep dive: operational efficiency and platform expansion drive growth amid margin pressures
items.summary: Online used car dealer Carvana (NYSE: CVNA) reported Q3 2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 42.4% year on year to $8.04 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.39 per share was 18.3% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
